t: You're at 15 Cowley Street, a building in Westminster, in the heart of political London. Annette Fountayne Puleston, who lived from 1855 to 1899, lived here. She is remembered as having married Philip Yorke the Second, of Erddig Hall, but she ran away from the marriage. It's a brief but striking human story set against a very official part of the city. There's little more recorded, so I'll leave it there.
